note: v59.70 (data audit R10, owner 2026-11-04): the pass criteria are the seven gate blockers themselves, not tuned numbers. scripts/build-validation-gates.mjs judges each one from the research backtest artifact (public-data/factor-backtest-longrun.json, or the fresh one the research-backtest workflow writes) and writes public-data/screener-validation-gate.json and public-data/model-validation-status.json. A requirement is met only when the artifact carries the evidence named in `evidence`; a status changes only when every required one is met.

delistingAndCorporateAction.label: delisted names and corporate actions
delistingAndCorporateAction.evidence: universe.includesDelisted is true and methodology.corporateActions is 'adjusted'

filingAvailableDate.label: fundamentals as of filing availability
filingAvailableDate.evidence: methodology.fundamentalsAsOf is 'filing-available-date' and no factor is excluded for look-ahead

turnoverModeled.label: turnover
turnoverModeled.evidence: every overallByHorizon entry has turnover.average finite over at least one rebalance (turnover.rebalanceCount > 0)

transactionCostsModeled.evidence: executionModel.transactionCostBps is a finite number and every overallByHorizon entry has a finite quantileSpreadNet (a scenario one-way cost on turnover; spread, impact and borrow stay outside it)

liveBacktestParity.label: live/backtest parity
liveBacktestParity.evidence: methodology.excludedFactors is empty and methodology.regimeWeightsValidated is true

marketLean.note: Declared 2026-11-15 before the first run of scripts/backtest-market-lean.mjs (owner approval the same day): the 시장 기울기 lean shows a direction word (매수 쪽 / 방어 쪽) only for a direction this criterion passes; otherwise it shows the condition counts. Judged by scripts/build-validation-gates.mjs into model-validation-status.json `marketLean`. Not to be changed after reading a result.

interval.method: moving-block bootstrap over the held-out daily series

buy.statistic: mean 21-session S&P 500 return on buy-lean sessions minus the mean on all sessions of the same span
buy.pass: held-out: non-overlapping buy-lean cases >= minEffectiveN and the interval lower bound > 0; in-sample: the point estimate > 0

defend.statistic: mean 21-session S&P 500 return on defend-lean sessions minus the mean on all sessions of the same span
defend.pass: held-out: non-overlapping defend-lean cases >= minEffectiveN and the interval upper bound < 0; in-sample: the point estimate < 0

reported: hit rate beside the base rate
marketLean.why: Against the all-session mean, not zero, because the index drifts up on about two sessions in three and a lean claims a change to that drift. The held-out last third (after an embargo of one horizon) is the judged part because the rule constants were set by hand on the history before it; the in-sample sign must agree so a held-out fluke cannot pass alone. The block bootstrap carries the overlap of 21-session windows and volatility clustering; 63 sessions is three horizons. 30 non-overlapping cases is the evidence-strength full line (src/domain/shared/evidence-strength.js). Each direction is judged on its own because each is its own claim. At least 4 of the 6 axes must be reconstructed (the live rule needs 4 to show a count at all), and the verdict names the axes it ran on.

marketLeanRisk.note: Declared 2026-11-15 09:33 UTC, before any risk statistic was computed (registered here unchanged from the pre-registration note of that run). Hypothesis: the six-US-axis condition count describes risk, not direction — sessions with more burdened (부담) axes are followed by more frequent deep drawdowns over the next 21 sessions than sessions with none. Study: scripts/backtest-market-lean-risk.mjs on the daily axis states of scripts/backtest-market-lean.mjs replayLean; judged by scripts/build-validation-gates.mjs into model-validation-status.json `marketLean.risk`; the 시장 상태 fold states that verdict. No revision of groups, target, threshold or horizon after results.
marketLeanRisk.readings: the daily axis states of replayLean (live buildMarketRegime on the trailing 420 rows; HY OAS from the session after its date; breadth unknown; credit only the last ~3 years); only sessions where the lean has a count (score != null, >= 4 known axes); burdened count = number of known US axes in state 'burden'
marketLeanRisk.target: D5 = 1 if the maximum drawdown of the S&P 500 close over the next 21 sessions, measured from the reading day's close (min over k=1..21 of close[i+k]/close[i] - 1), is <= -5%, else 0
marketLeanRisk.statistic: P(D5 | HIGH) - P(D5 | LOW), in percentage points, over all daily readings of the span (overlapping windows; the bootstrap handles dependence)

interval.method: moving-block bootstrap over the span's daily series in session order

marketLeanRisk.split: held-out = last third of the 21-session readings (the direction harness's splitAt); first two thirds = readings before splitAt - 21 (embargo), further split at its middle reading into halves A and B with a 21-session embargo before B
pass: held-out: HIGH and LOW each have >= 30 non-overlapping cases, and the 95% interval lower bound > 0
second guard (the held-out third was already looked at, for returns, in the direction test): point estimate > 0 in half A and in half B separately
reported: 5th percentile and mean of the 21-session return per group
the volatility axis alone and the VIX band
burdened count among non-volatility axes within volatility-axis strata
the same targets at 5 and 63 sessions (reference only)
